lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Blobs are centered at the intersection points of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal planes of spot alignment, forming a lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges running parallel along the mid-to-upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity highlights (dorsal) to low-intensity shadows (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remora (Echeneidae) are visible attached to the ventral-lateral region beneath the pectoral fin.
